nodes.rationale: rtk <cmd> is checked as both rtk and <cmd>; shell-string forms and unknown options are refused because the analyser cannot see inside them.

nodes.norm_label: prefer rtk compressed output for command tokens
nodes.rationale: Same signal with far fewer tokens; but do not wrap commands whose full output must be parsed exactly (e.g. a diff to be applied as a patch), and file reads must go through moca's tracked read/search/ls tools.

nodes.norm_label: extensibility: skills + slash commands + shell allowlist (no plugins)
nodes.rationale: No binary plugin system, probably ever — three composable standards-based mechanisms cover it; a fifth mechanism would need a design revision.

nodes.label: MCP lazy by design (pi-mcp-adapter evidence: 100 servers → 0 running)
nodes.norm_label: mcp lazy by design (pi-mcp-adapter evidence: 100 servers → 0 running)
nodes.rationale: Eager injection of every server's schemas is the single fastest way to destroy a lean context; one ~200-token proxy tool + persisted index keeps prompt cost ~200 tokens.

nodes.norm_label: threat model: permissions guard, not a sandbox
nodes.rationale: Stated plainly: shell is analysed, not contained — a real shell parse (mvdan.cc/sh) is required because a hand-rolled splitter cannot see substitutions, subshells and redirects; OS sandboxing is a v2 discussion.

nodes.norm_label: strict jsonc config decode, no unknown keys
nodes.rationale: Unknown keys are rejected so typos fail fast; adding a config key requires defaults + validation + SPECS update.

nodes.label: Anthropic decision: api_key only
nodes.rationale: Anthropic's terms prohibit third-party developers offering Claude.ai login or routing requests through consumer-plan credentials; config validation rejects providers.anthropic.auth=oauth with the recorded reason.

nodes.label: Policy gate: unclear terms are treated as not permitted
nodes.norm_label: policy gate: unclear terms are treated as not permitted
nodes.rationale: Before any OAuth code for a provider, the vendor's terms are verified live; unclear is treated as not permitted; no workarounds or spoofed client identities.

nodes.label: Symlinked skill directories are skipped by design
nodes.norm_label: symlinked skill directories are skipped by design
nodes.rationale: Skill bodies load through the read jail, so installed skills must be copied, not symlinked.

nodes.label: JSONC over TOML (house dotfiles merge + OpenCode ecosystem shapes)
nodes.norm_label: jsonc over toml (house dotfiles merge + opencode ecosystem shapes)
nodes.rationale: stdlib-parseable (pre-pass + encoding/json, zero config deps), matches the house merge scripts, and is the native shape of the OpenCode-ecosystem configs mcp import reads — one parser everywhere.

nodes.label: String-literal-aware JSONC comment stripping (// in URLs survive)
nodes.norm_label: string-literal-aware jsonc comment stripping (// in urls survive)
nodes.rationale: A naive first-//-cut parser destroys URLs in config; comments must be replaced in a way that preserves encoding/json error offsets.

nodes.community_name: Seven frozen tools with golden schemas
nodes.norm_label: failing-test investigation protocol enforced by edit tool
nodes.rationale: While a failing test run is unresolved, edit refuses until the agent read the failing test and located the cause — the §14 loop's investigation steps enforced rather than advisory.
